opening.argument: The $3,500 package is promoted as delivering 1,150 Clubcoins and an immediate $718 benefit, alongside claimed daily passive income and team-based commissions. Invitations and a supplied referral link connect those financial inducements to recruitment, presenting a flow from payment to benefits and team participation. That combination supports finding a scam involving paid mining returns. The review framing and account disclaimer provide context, but they do not verify the stated package terms, payouts, or external claims.
